effect_description_eng:
[Start of Your Turn] If you have 2 or less memory, set it to 3. 
[On Play] Reveal the top 4 cards of your deck. Add 1 card with the [X Antibody] trait among them to your hand. Place the remaining cards at the bottom of your deck in any order.
inherited_effect_description_eng: Security Effect [Security] Play this card without paying its memory cost.
